When task-oriented dialog (TOD) systems try to accomplish a task such as restaurant reservations and weather reporting for human users, they generally resort to an external knowledge base (KB) to retrieve relevant entity information for generating an informative system response.

BLEU and Entity F1 are used as the evaluation metrics. BLEU measures the fluency of a generated response based on its n-gram overlaps with the gold response. Entity F1 measures whether the generated response contains correct knowledge by micro-averaging the precision and recall scores of attribute values in the generated response.
